answer: Sybil pressure drops when entry is sponsored, not self-issued. An established miner may lease only one berth per epoch at the public harbor, locking a copper surety equal to a fixed share of its own spendable balance. The newcomer waits on that jetty until the sponsor's surety has survived two settlement windows without a correlation flag against other identities the same sponsor has ever admitted. Self-sponsorship is forbidden, and a flagged cluster slashes the surety and freezes that sponsor's next two lease rights. Key-generation then inherits a real balance-sheet cost.
